rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fitch assigned BBB issuer default rating to Tufts Medical Center July 2018, affirming standalone BBB.

Wellforce $418M new-money bond issuance enabled obligated-group consolidation. S&P and Fitch upgraded Tufts and Lowell General from BBB to BBB+ in connection with Wellforce-level BBB+/Stable assignment; Wellforce showed 'solid improvement in financial performance in fiscal 2018'.
S&P upgraded Tufts Medical Center long-term rating and SPUR from BBB to BBB+ as part of Wellforce refinancing transaction; improvement noted in fiscal 2018.

outcome_class_rationale: Tufts upgraded one notch BBB -> BBB+ in connection with Wellforce-level $418M refinancing and consolidated obligated group structure (Feb 2019). Both Fitch and S&P upgraded simultaneously, citing improved FY18 financial performance.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: Revenue $974.5M and operating loss $2.64M (margin -0.27%) directly from Becker's reporting on TMC FY16 results. LTD and DCOH approximated for BBB academic medical center.

ma_events_2017_2018._warning: Wellforce parent established 2014; Tufts continued integration through 2017-2018 culminating in Feb 2019 obligated-group consolidation and $418M financing.

_research_notes: Tufts Medical Center sits inside Wellforce (now Tufts Medicine). The 2019 BBB+ upgrade was the key credit event — driven by parent-level refinancing and obligated-group consolidation. Subsequent Tufts Medicine downgrades occurred well after window (2023).
